hints.text: Sort the array in descending order to pick the largest elements first.

hints.title: Greedy Element Selection
hints.text: Pick elements one by one from largest to smallest, adding to your chosen subset.

hints.title: Check Majority Sum Condition
hints.text: Stop as soon as the sum of chosen elements strictly exceeds the sum of non-chosen elements.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minSubsequence(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        nums.sort(reverse=True)
        total = sum(nums)
        sub_sum = 0
        res = []
        for x in nums:
            sub_sum += x
            res.append(x)
            if sub_sum > total - sub_sum:
                break
        return res
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^N subsequences and checking sums is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting greedily selects the largest numbers to minimize subsequence length in O(N log N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate sorts descending and picks elements until subset sum > total_sum - subset_sum.
complexity.notes: Subsequence must be strictly greater than remaining sum.
